mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId,relation_id AS relationId,campaign_id AS campaignId,organization_id AS organizationId,shop_id AS shopId, participant_id AS participantId,token_id AS tokenId,definition_id AS definitionId,definition_version AS definitionVersion,generation, artifact_id AS artifactId,policy_hash AS policyHash,bound_at AS boundAt,deadline_at AS qualifyDeadline,consent_version AS consentVersion, consent_hash AS consentHash,state,invitee_key AS subjectKey,subject_key_version AS keyVersion,invitee_cipher AS cipher,encryption_key_id AS encryptionKeyId FROM mk_referral_relation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND relation_id=#{relation} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_referral_evaluation_task(tenant_id,relation_id,participant_id,organization_id,shop_id,requested_revision,trigger_resource_id, trigger_version,reason,status,available_at,available_seconds,available_nanos,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{relation},#{participant},#{organization},#{shop},1,#{resource},#{version},#{reason},'PENDING',#{now},#{seconds},#{nanos},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE requested_revision=requested_revision+1,trigger_resource_id=#{resource},trigger_version=#{version},reason=#{reason}, status='PENDING',available_at=#{now},available_seconds=#{seconds},available_nanos=#{nanos},lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,fence=fence+1,row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=#{now}
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId,relation_id AS relationId,participant_id AS participantId,organization_id AS organizationId,shop_id AS shopId, requested_revision AS requestedRevision,processed_revision AS processedRevision,status,available_seconds AS availableSeconds,available_nanos AS availableNanos, lease_owner AS leaseOwner,lease_until AS leaseUntil,fence FROM mk_referral_evaluation_task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND relation_id=#{relation} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE mk_referral_evaluation_task SET status='PROCESSING',lease_owner=#{owner},lease_until=#{until},fence=fence+1,row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND relation_id=#{relation} AND fence=#{fence} AND requested_revision=#{requested}
mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id AS tenantId,relation_id AS relationId,participant_id AS participantId,goal_type AS goalType,policy_hash AS policyHash,state,reason,counted, ever_qualified AS everQualified,qualification_revision AS revision,evidence_resource_id AS evidenceResourceId,evidence_state_version AS evidenceVersion, member_revision AS memberRevision,member_policy AS memberPolicy,first_order_policy AS firstOrderPolicy,proof_id AS proofId,due_seconds AS dueSeconds,due_nanos AS dueNanos,task_revision AS taskRevision,member_evidence_digest AS memberEvidenceDigest,member_quarantined AS memberQuarantined,registration_anchor_digest AS registrationAnchorDigest FROM mk_referral_qualification WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND relation_id=#{relation} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_referral_progress(tenant_id,participant_id,created_at,updated_at) VALUES(#{tenant},#{participant},#{now},#{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE progress_revision=progress_revision
